seo.title: Expert Garage, Office, & Estate Cleanouts in Greater Toronto Area
seo.description: Live Junk Free provides professional garage, eviction, office, and estate junk cleanout services in the Greater Toronto Area. Affordable, hassle-free cleanup solutions tailored to your needs!

blocks.text: Contact us for fast, reliable, and eco-friendly service
Cleanouts across Toronto and the GTA

items.title: Estate cleanouts
text: Clearing a loved one’s home with care, once the family has set aside what they’re keeping.

items.title: House cleanouts
text: Whole homes or single rooms. The price and timing depend on the volume and access.

items.title: Apartment cleanouts
text: Condos and apartments. Please arrange elevator or loading-dock approval with your building.

items.title: Hoarding cleanouts
text: Discreet, respectful removal of the items you agree to, at a pace that suits you.

items.title: Storage unit cleanouts
text: You arrange access with the facility and mark anything you’re keeping; we remove the rest.

items.title: Garage cleanouts
text: A whole-garage clear-out. For just a few items, see garage junk removal.

items.title: Eviction cleanouts
text: For landlords and property managers who have confirmed their legal right to remove the contents.

items.title: Basement cleanouts
text: Stored boxes, old furniture and clutter carried up and hauled away. Tell us about any damp items.

items.title: Office cleanouts
text: Desks, chairs and equipment from offices. Tell us about building rules and timing.

blocks.text: Big or small, tell us what needs to go.

items.q: What types of items do you remove?
a: We remove a wide range of items, including furniture, appliances, electronics, mattresses, construction debris, yard waste, and more. If you’re unsure if we can take a specific item, feel free to reach out to us.
Our pricing is based on the volume of items being removed, the type of items, and the difficulty of removal. You can also request a free estimate by contacting us or using our online booking system.

items.q: Do you recycle or donate items?
a: Yes, we’re committed to responsible disposal practices. Whenever possible, we recycle items or donate them to local charities. Our goal is to minimize waste and give back to the community whenever we can.
We proudly serve Greater Toronto Area. If you’re unsure if we cover your area, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We’re always expanding our service areas to better serve our customers.

items.q: How far in advance do I need to schedule a pickup?
a: We strive to accommodate our customers’ schedules as much as possible. {{fact:scheduling}}
